descriptionChirho: To be anxious, worried, concerned, or afraid. All occurrences share the same Qal sense of inner distress or apprehension. In 1 Sam 9:5, Saul's father worries (weda'ag) about them. In 1 Sam 10:2, he worries about the lost donkeys. In Ps 38:18, the psalmist says 'I am anxious' ('ed'ag) over his sin. In Isa 57:11, God asks whom Zion feared (da'agt). In Jer 17:8, the blessed man does not worry (yid'ag) in drought. In Jer 38:19, Zedekiah fears (do'eg) the Jews who defected. In Jer 42:16, the people are worried (do'agim) about the sword in Egypt. Glosses uniformly: arb qaliqa/khaa'if, deu besorgt, kor geokjeong/duryeoweo, spa preocupar/temer, hin chintit.
